# Material 3 Expressive

Material 3 Expressive generates full tonal palettes of surfaces, containers and accents from a single base hue, in the Material You idiom. Its dark mode adapts to the chosen accent, and it adds Android 16-style grouped lists for settings and navigation. The recorded description says popular community plugins get native-styled support while desktop polish continues.

![Material 3 Expressive screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/joangen/Obsidian-Material-3-Expressive/HEAD/assets/Material-3-Expressive-06E4C5568EB40B24643BC469BC3738A7.png)
